q1_issues.issue: "The nightmoths left silken threads on the lanterns" gives the threads Patient, but leaving/depositing does not create, destroy, consume or physically change them, so the stated change test yields Theme (the same choice is repeated inside the rule at index 65).

q2_gaps: of-phrase on an agent-nominalization ("the keepers of the East Row"): the nominalization-object `Of` oblique is defined for nouns naming an act, result or quality, while the agent-nominalization section says a referring use is an ordinary kind -- neither settles whether "keepers of X" takes `Of` or the genitive `Possession`, and the parse uses `Of` here but `Possession` for "the lanterns of the East Row" in the same sentence
partitive level word "many" ("Many of the nightmoths gathered"): the enumerated vague-word lexicon for the `ProportionOf` level slot is most / half / some / few / none and does not cover "many"
notes: The collective/distributive contrast is handled correctly throughout -- "together lit" and "Together, the lanterns produced" get group-only events while the unmarked plural clauses add the per-member rule, and collective "gathered" stays group-only. Compound decomposition (mire_essence, mist_light, nightmoth, silken_thread, sea_water, clay_vessel), the "that night" term propagation, the "by evening" TimeAtMost and the partitive superset reuse of sk_nightmoths_1 all follow the instruction set.
